# A2.04 Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then)

## Owner
A2

## Stage
Understand

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
—

## Input (reads)
User stories

## Steps
1. For each story write 2-5 Given/When/Then criteria.
2. Each criterion has one observable result.
3. Note platform differences where the source states them.
4. Mark unknown results TBD

## Output (writes)
Acceptance criteria per story

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/stories/<ID>/acceptance-criteria.md`

## Verification
Each criterion has one observable result; no 'should work well'

## Checkpoints raised
- none
